name: Ealdmaine Caverns: the disguise corpse becomes clickable for a player who takes the quest beside it
contract: Issue #8273. Dead Ealdmaine Ealdir 164225 stands next to Randec, who gives Ealdmaine Caverns 175036. Its
spell-click rows (365016/365017 attire by gender, 365094 Ealdmaine reaction) are gated on CONDITION_QUESTSTATE
175036-175038, so a client that saw the corpse before taking the quest received it without the spell-click flag.
Expected: taking the quest re-sends the corpse's NPC flags with spell-click, and a click applies the Ealdir
reaction aura and credits the Ealdir Disguise objective. The case joins world phase 1 to use spawn 9960047.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the corpse is spawned
Let the corpse reach the client
Take Ealdmaine Caverns beside the corpse
the client is told the corpse can be clicked
the Ealdmaine Caverns reaction is applied
and the Ealdir Disguise objective counts
